ruleDefinitions.name: Active Directory Computers Enumeration With Get-AdComputer
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "Get-AdComputer" to enumerate Computers or properties within Active Directory. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-AdComputer\\ .*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Filter\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-LDAPFilter\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Properties\\ .*")))
